item.title: Two Icebergs
item.description: Two icebergs meet underwater, scour submerged weight, and gaze across salty dark waters.

item.title: First Kiss
item.description: It would feel like opening a very old book to the right page, by accident, or straining to see over the crowds as Jesus walks by.

item.title: Two Red Pears

item.title: Over and Over
item.description: The same things must be said over and over because we are always forgetting, or maybe we never quite grasp what they mean.

item.title: No Shortcuts
item.description: There are no shortcuts on the road to ourselves. It takes time.

item.title: My body hurts
item.description: My body hurts but I must be imagining it. The man on TV says it's fine, and he's never lied to me before.

item.title: Northstar
item.description: She twinkles in the dark like the last hope for sailors stranded who long to go home...northstar shine brighter, consume the chaff, burn hearts into form…

item.title: I Knew
item.description: The clouds parted, a ray of light appeared and time slowed down for angelsong. I knew I had to have her, or I would never be happy.

item.title: Echoes of Ariadne
item.description: Her footsteps echo through the labyrinth, haunting desolate halls with the memory of adventure...the minotaur lies in wait.

item.title: Dignity III
item.description: Dignity is giving from abundance

item.title: Antheia
item.description: Antheia gathers her blossoms from an unwatered bed. It has been a dry season. Cold wind comes to challenge the sun, but she answers with aromatic aster.

item.title: Democracy
item.description: I don't like Democracy because most people are stupid. I like Democracy because leaders are stupid too.

item.title: Article of Faith
item.description: Our article of faith is a blank page... we worship that page with all the zeal we can muster.

item.title: Strange Breeze

item.title: Inner Beloved
item.description: You do not hate men, you hate the inner masculine, your beloved within. You must come to terms. You must hear what he has to say.

item.title: Beatrice, Not Virgil
item.description: Beatrice, not Virgil, knows the way to heaven.

item.title: Brown Hawk
item.description: Brown hawk soars over white in a gentle breeze, blue sky always in view, never free.

item.title: You Still Are
item.description: I still weep for the thought of you, nightwatcher, eternal muse, the one from the stars...yes, you are what I wanted. You still are.

item.title: In My Experience
